# `spatialdata`

Discover or explicitly select spatial assets and optionally build a validated SpatialData Zarr

- Wrapper: [`job_spatialdata.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_spatialdata.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_segmentation`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.spatialdata_builder`

## Inputs

- spatialdata.root plus optional explicit AnnData, masks, image panels, histology, region-label, and MaxFuse paths

## Outputs

- spatialdata.output_path when spatialdata.action=build
- outputs/<execution_id>_SpatialData_Assembly/{tables,summaries}/

## Configuration

- general, spatialdata, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl spatialdata
```
